mode: existing-CLI fit + validation only; no source edits, no commits, no test-bank evaluation, no extra experiment
question: Does training on ONLY the added later-decision bank (v14_train_later_probe_v2.jsonl, 33 decisions / 9 seeds / 2600 trials) change gate-bank behavior vs the original multitask fit (285 decisions / 22 seeds / 22697 usable train samples from v14_collect_v1.jsonl)?
confound_note: The added-only corpus is ~8.7x smaller in decisions and 9 vs 22 seeds, so this run is CONFOUNDED by training-corpus size and seed diversity; it cannot prove or refute the label-noise hypothesis from v14_label_and_rollout_diagnostic.json.

fit.command: python tools/fit_evaluator.py --train results/evaluator/v14_train_later_probe_v2.jsonl --val results/evaluator/v14_collect_v1.jsonl --test results/evaluator/v14_collect_v1.jsonl --arch attention --hidden 128 --seed 0 --epochs 10 --loss-profile multitask --out results/evaluator/v14_added_only_e10_s0.pt
fit.val_test_bank: results/evaluator/v14_collect_v1.jsonl internal splits (val = 3 seeds/52 decisions; test = 1 seed, used by fit contract only, never for selection or metrics; test_used=false)

reasons: validation split is tuning evidence, not an independent test gate

comparison_to_original.matching: 2981/2981 paired records matched on (seed, decision_id); anchor/evaluation values identical by construction; per-decision advantage deltas computed for all matched decisions

matched_delta.definition: added_only advantage - original advantage, decision-weighted, seed-cluster bootstrap (balatro_sim.eval_metrics.bootstrap_seed_ci, 2000 resamples, seed 0)

calibration_brier.note: Brier over the same 238824 usable trials, matched identities

comparison_to_original.interpretation: Added-only training moves the large validation bank's paired advantage from -0.268 pp to -0.070 pp (matched delta +0.198 pp, 95% CI [-0.193, +0.588]) and reduces Brier/regret slightly. All CIs span zero; nothing separable. Because the added bank has ~1/9 the decisions and fewer seeds than the original, size/data-diversity is confounded with any per-row effect; this cannot prove or disprove the label-noise hypothesis.

conclusion: Training on the added later-decision bank alone yields an INCONCLUSIVE, statistically indistinguishable gate-bank result vs the original multitask fit (matched delta +0.198 pp advantage, CI spans 0). The 9-seed corpus is far smaller than the original, so no claim about label noise vs data volume is established.
